description.value: River Dikhow at Shivsagar in Shivsagar district of Assam continues to flow in above normal flood situation at 11:00 pm today. At 11:00 pm, it was flowing at a level of 91.4 m with rising trend which is 0.00 m above its Warning Level of 91.4 m and 1.00 m below its Danger Level of 92.4 m.
